speaker: judith_sadler
text: Sit, Will. You stand in my bakehouse like a man waiting to be paid for it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will sit. I came to make Anne's purchase, and I have already found I do not know the answer she knows.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The household loaf, Judith. The same weight as Thursday last, if the week has not changed it.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: The penny is the same penny. The loaf is lighter than I like to own. I am telling Anne. I am not teaching you, Will.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: He tells the truth to the person who buys. You may listen, now you are sitting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am listening. I had a small speech about the wheat, and I am not giving it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Good. The wheat is their business. Ask the gingerbread, and then stop helping me.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Gingerbread. A penny is a number I can spend. I am saying it before anyone improves it.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Two pennies, if I am in the shop. Susanna is not here. Hers can travel in paper.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: A penny each for the two who are standing here. The third in a paper. Anne knows the paper better than I do.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I finish it, now I have heard the weight. A penny each, Susanna's in paper, and the household loaf at the weight Anne asked.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: That is the bargain. Thou hast listened. Finish it.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: Finished. I will not make you say whether it is a gift. It is a purchase. Sit until the paper is twisted.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: The loaf's weight is the loaf's weight. There is no moral riding on it. Anne has the penny for the loaf. The children have theirs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I knew less than she did about the goods, and less about thy answer. I have that clearly.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The paper is Susanna's. She is at home. Do not spend her penny on a speech between here and the door.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I will carry the paper and not open it. Opening would be a third cake, and I have counted to two.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I laughed at the Cross. I am not laughing at a loaf. Sadler says it is light. That is his fact, told to Mother.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Told to Anne. If it becomes a story about me, Will, it has walked further than I sent it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It stays in the shop. I am not collecting light loaves to carry to London.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: Then take the paper. You buy like a man who has remembered he is not the baker.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: He remembered it late, and the finish was clean. That will do for a Thursday.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: One penny. It will be in my mouth before we are out of the High Street. That is my receipt.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Mine is in my hand. The paper is in the other. Two facts, and the sword is not one of them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Home, then. The loaf was hers to know. The pennies were the easy part.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Easy is the right size. I make no more of the namesake than of the gingerbread.
